Skin Care

Simple Skin Care Routine

A practical routine starts with a few dependable steps before adding stronger products.

Routine Guide

Start With Three Steps

A basic skin care routine can be cleanser, moisturizer, and sunscreen. This is enough for many people, especially when the goal is clean, comfortable, protected skin.

Serums, toners, exfoliants, and masks can be useful, but they work best when added for a clear reason.

Morning Routine

  • Cleanse gently or rinse with water if your skin is dry.
  • Use a moisturizer that matches your skin type.
  • Apply sunscreen as the final morning step.

Evening Routine

  • Remove makeup and sunscreen carefully.
  • Cleanse without scrubbing.
  • Apply serum if you use one, then moisturizer.

What To Avoid

Avoid adding too many active ingredients at once. If the skin starts stinging, peeling, or feeling tight, simplify the routine and let the barrier recover.
